label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 150
title: Multi-modal: feasibility triage view - build-host feasibility (ideation) + destination runtime & shipping mode (post-build)
body:
## Goal
Surface the two-phase feasibility triage:
- PHASE 1 (ideation): the build host's hardware (GPU/VRAM/RAM/disk) and, per modality, whether it can be built locally or needs API; verdict go/conditional/no-go.
- PHASE 2 (post-build): the destination system profile and the chosen shipping mode (bundle weights / API-BYOK / hosted / hybrid) + required hardware/keys.

## AC
- Phase 1 cards per modality with reason + required API keys/GPU.
- Phase 2 available after build; shows shipping mode + SKU + end-user requirements.
_note: two-phase feasibility (build-host at ideation, destination at packaging)
